rule: quant C9 (eval1_signoff_1107, amended at the re-verify): Each of the 3 samples pools walks until 1,000 trades (at most 8 walks). A pair fails if |t_pooled| >= 3.5, or if |mean| >= 0.03 R/trade with |t_pooled| >= 2. A failure is re-tested once on 3 fresh samples, and it is confirmed only if the retest fails with the same sign. A pair with fewer than 30 trades after 24 walks is excluded from EVAL-1 screening and listed (sparse). failed: unit|control pairs with a confirmed failure (strict xfail in the guard; their units are not screened). tests/test_catalogue_random_walk.py keeps both lists exact.
